title: Noise cannot help quantum-enhanced MCMC: exactness is free, advantage is not
description: Manuscript, certification scripts, figure generators, pre-registrations, and numerical results for the Goldilocks study of noise in quantum-enhanced Markov-chain Monte Carlo. We classify the noise channels that preserve the sampler's exactness (transpose-closed Kraus sets; Lindblad extension), bound the bias of amplitude damping, refute gap-monotonicity, establish the pre-registered envelope law (noise never beats the best of the coherent quench and trivial classical kernels; 49/50 cells, one disclosed exception), and measure the quench's mechanism against a fourteen-kernel exact-tier zoo: concentration at Hamming distance predicts advantage, a shell oracle suffices, and exact classical emulation pays a certification cost growing at least one order of magnitude per four spins. Companion experiment code and data live in the tunnelvision repository archived alongside this deposit.
